note: v4 (#862): the reconciler. `groups` still places every rail row; `unlisted` now accounts for the shell surfaces the rail does not owe, by address and reason, and `data:check` E43 fails the build on any route under app/(mainlayout) that neither list names. The drawn rail is unchanged by this version.

items.note: #1252, re-homed 2026-11-19 at the owner's request — the project spec is a group of its own, drawn above the Admin heading, and it is the only row there. It is not an operator destination: it is the one staff-adjacent surface a stakeholder reads and reviews against. needs: stakeholder is the rung (between member and support), and capability: spec-read is the gate the rung cannot express — support outranks a stakeholder and is refused the spec, so the row names both. The group carries no label on purpose: a one-row group sitting above the first heading does not get one, and any heading would repeat the row's own word. One row, one href.
#542 phase 2 — the one queue a support seat works, and the only row in this group below admin. The hub page links neither this nor the health row.
#542 phase 2 — the hub for its own subtree (users, templates, relationships). It had no row anywhere in the UI before this, and it leads the group.
#542 phase 2 — the console's five existing destinations, in the order they were carried.
#505 — billing control: the plan each relationship carries, and the owner's comp.
#507 — the broadcast: a one-off notice to the news list.

#901 — the docs home renders the 117-page manifest and had no row, so the tree was URL-only. It sits after the review shelf and before the log: the reference you look things up in, then what the rows above it did.

#1126 — the CRUD & Permissions matrix, directly after Docs because it is the second reference: the docs say how the product works, this says which role may do what. `review` is the checklist glyph and no name in the set draws a table; the console's own review row lives in group-support, so the reuse never reads as the same destination in one rail.

#1138 — the transactional-mail override editor, the third reference row: the docs say how the product works, CRUD says who may do it, and this says what it writes to a person. `inbox` is the glyph the console's own mail surface uses, and it is not drawn by any other row in this group — a distinct letter is the point of a rail. It carries `needs: admin` so a support seat does not see it, which is the issue's own condition.
#503 — the log every row above it commits into, and last in the group for that reason: an operator reads it after acting.

#1129 — Start, the signed-in landing: the computed Next Step, the two active relationships and four templates. `exact` because `/dashboard` is a parent path of the rows below it, and a prefix rule would light Start beside every one of them. This is the row #620 removed when the Overview stopped being a destination; it comes back as a different page.
#620 — the relationship and its assessment, in one list. Second since #1129, because the rail now opens on Start.
#620 — one destination, two tabs: the catalogue and what this member owns. /dashboard/library is a 308 to this tab (next.config.mjs).

#1131 — one thread per relationship, last of the member's destinations as the v2 rail draws it (Start · My Relationships · Templates · Chat). NOT /chat: that address is the quiz product's conversations, gated to the quiz brand (#300), and it answers 404 on the build this rail belongs to.
#665 — the review shelf: published artifacts, each with its to-dos and its feedback. One row, between Broadcast and the audit log.
The first-run tour points at this row (data-tour="help"), still in the Support group — group-support is the help/contact pair, not a second workspace.

unlisted.reason: The brand and audience profile (#906). Its door is the admin notice bar's CTA, which is on every screen; a rail row would be a second control for one destination.
A console detail list (#478) — reached from the console hub's own row, and it lists what My Relationships lists for the other role.
A console detail list (#478) — reached from the console hub, and the operator's view of the same catalogue the member's Templates row opens.
A console detail list (#478) — reached from the console hub; an operator's queue, never a destination of its own.
A docs sub-surface (#901) — inside the docs home's own tree, which is what the `admin-docs` row opens. A rail row per docs page is what that home exists to avoid.
A docs sub-surface (#901) — the release notes inside the docs home's tree.

The growth model (#1095). The owner kept the page and removed its rail row, because a screen charting a simulated business does not belong in an operator's rail — so it stays URL-only by that ruling, and this entry is where the ruling is written down.
The project spec's validation page (#1252). The `admin-spec` row opens the spec, and its submenu is how its pages are reached — a rail row per spec page would be the submenu again, in the rail.
The operator's template list — the alignment product's authoring tree, alignment-only and admin-gated, reached from the console hub.
The published-template catalogue (#146). Two ways in already exist — the Templates row and a relationship's own screen — and a third would make the rail a list of form entries.
The create flow's failure screen (#1226) — a state a browser lands on when a write throws, never a destination.
My Assessments (#877). #1129 retired its rail row when Start took the top slot; the listing still answers at its own address, and the sessions are one click from My Relationships.

The member's billing surface (#1132) — reached from a relationship's own screen and the account menu. The v2 reference draws Payment as the last rail row; when the document gains that row, this entry is deleted.
The recorded walkthrough (#898). The rail's How It Works row is `/dashboard/help`; this is the signed-out visitor's copy of the same story, reached from the public chrome.
The community leaderboard (#175) — gated on `community.leaderboard` and off on the builds this rail ships. A row would advertise a surface that answers 404.
Quiz News & Updates — the quiz catalogue's news list; the alignment build's announcements arrive through the broadcast and the marketing chrome.
The palette's view-all page (#156). The header's search opens it, and a rail row beside a search field is a second way to the same results.
The signed-in person's own profile (#164) — opened from the account menu, which is where a person looks for themselves.
The account support page's shorter address — the rail's Support row is `/dashboard/support`, which is the workspace surface #542 phase 1 built; this one is the page it replaced and still answers.
